critical.signal_rule: Every answerable query belongs to exactly one signal cohort.
critical.risk_rule: A query belongs to every applicable risk cohort.
critical.gate_rule: A release candidate must satisfy every predeclared critical-cohort threshold independently; an aggregate average cannot compensate for a failed critical cohort. This taxonomy version does not itself choose numeric thresholds.

general.task_rule: Every query belongs to exactly one primary task cohort.
general.diagnostic_rule: A query may belong to any number of diagnostic cohorts. General cohorts are reported and compared but do not independently block a release.

language_rule: Language is reported independently as go, typescript, tsx, or mixed and is not encoded as a critical/general cohort.
operational_rule: Freshness, stale-row, generation, and atomic-publication checks are separate 100-percent operational gates rather than static retrieval-question cohorts.
scoring_rule: Report stage-separated metrics and exact denominators. Do not compute a weighted total score. Multi-requirement uses CompleteRequirementHit@k; known-hard-negative uses KnownHardNegativeHit@k.
